channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Collin Sexton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Collin Sexton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Wendell Carter on Collin Sexton
item.description:
After spending time with the Cavaliers, Utah Jazz, Charlotte Hornets and a stint with the Chicago Bulls, Sexton now brings his high-volume scoring ability (15.4 PPG, 40.1% 3PT) to the Los Angeles Lakers.

“I worked out with Collin Sexton—a guy I grew up with, played AAU with him since I was a kid,”

Wendell Carter on Collin Sexton, Oct 13, 2026. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Will Hardy on Collin Sexton
item.description:
“It’s better to try and get a good shot in a scramble situation. But once Collin started to retreat dribble, I started calling timeout. It was obviously loud in there. The hope would be to have had a few more seconds than two. But, yeah, it’s tough.”

Will Hardy on Collin Sexton, Dec 2, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Mike Conley on Collin Sexton
item.description:
Jazz PG Mike Conley, on if he's expecting to play tonight:

“I am, yeah. I was hopeful to play tonight regardless, but with (Collin Sexton) out, obviously, it kinda helps make the decision a little bit easier.”

Mike Conley on Collin Sexton, Dec 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Will Hardy on Collin Sexton
item.description:
“His work ethic is one of the best that I’ve come across in my time in the NBA.Really happy for Collin in his first game here in front of the home crowd and that he was able to make some big plays down the stretch.”

Will Hardy on Collin Sexton, Oct 20, 2022. Source: deseret.com.

item.title: Darius Garland on Collin Sexton
item.description:
Sexton and Garland cooperating in more side-to-side action could jolt the Cavs out of the thudding dribble-dribble-dribble lifelessness that infected their offense last season.

“Sometimes it got stagnant because people like to watch me and Collin,”

Darius Garland on Collin Sexton, Oct 18, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Collin Sexton
item.description:
Chris Fedor:#Cavs J.B. Bickerstaff on the importance of a long-term extension with Collin Sexton:

“We’ve put a lot into Collin, working with him. We believe in him. Would love to have him here as part of what we’re doing”

JB Bickerstaff on Collin Sexton, Oct 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Collin Sexton
item.description:
#Cavs J.B. Bickerstaff on Collin Sexton’s ejection from the game for the flagrant foul 2 called on Sexton:

“It was disappointing for Collin. I know that’s not the way he wanted to end the season.”

JB Bickerstaff on Collin Sexton, May 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @kelseyyrusso.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Jarrett Allen, Collin Sexton
item.description:
#CavsJ.B. Bickerstaff on the verbal spat between Sexton & Allen:

“I don’t think it was that big of a deal. We discussed it and we moved on. If you never have conflict, you never have resolution. So it’s OK to have a little bit of conflict as long as it leads to a resolution.”

JB Bickerstaff on Jarrett Allen, Collin Sexton, Feb 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Cedi Osman on Taurean Prince, Collin Sexton
item.description:
“He made like 14 or 15 points in a row, and then there was good defense on him, but then he found TP (new Cavalier Taurean Prince) in the corner for a 3-point shot that was wide open. That was a beautiful play from Collin. He could have taken that one too but saw TP was open, and that was the right play, so he made the right play. You can see from his first year until now — he’s just getting better every day.”

Cedi Osman on Taurean Prince, Collin Sexton, Jan 21, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Brad Daugherty on Collin Sexton, Darius Garland
item.description:
When Daugherty came back to the Cleveland area this past season and mingled with the team, he had opportunities to speak with Cavs players both young and old.

“It’s really funny because Collin Sexton is an excellent young man, and Darius Garland and these guys look at you and they know who you are, but they kind of don’t because they (are too young),”

Brad Daugherty on Collin Sexton, Darius Garland, Sep 3, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Koby Altman on LeBron James, Collin Sexton
item.description:
#Cavs Koby Altman on what he thinks LeBron thinks of Collin Sexton:

“I think the pick along with our youth and our momentum as a franchise, for LeBron and for everybody, I think there’s a real energy here. And I think the talent level of Collin I’m almost sure LeBron recognizes.”

Koby Altman on LeBron James, Collin Sexton, Jun 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Jay Bilas on Collin Sexton
item.description:
Jay Bilas, a college basketball analyst for ESPN, ranks Sexton higher than Young.

“I think Collin Sexton is overall the best point guard prospect in the draft,”

Jay Bilas on Collin Sexton, Jun 21, 2018. Source: Orlando Sentinel.
